messages.content: "在一個物理實驗中，你被給予兩個電荷。第一個電荷的大小為5庫倫，第二個電荷的大小為10庫倫。這些電荷相距2公尺。你被要求計算這些電荷之間的電磁力。你進行了兩次實驗。第一次，電荷被放置在真空中，其介電常數為8.854 x 10^-12 F/m。第二次，電荷被放置在一個相對介電常數為5 x 10^-12 F/m的介質中。你能計算出兩種情況下電荷之間的電磁力嗎？"

function.name: electromagnetic_force
function.description: Calculate the electromagnetic force between two charges placed at a certain distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

charge1.description: The magnitude of the first charge in coulombs.

charge2.description: The magnitude of the second charge in coulombs.

distance.description: The distance between the two charges in meters.

medium_permittivity.description: The relative permittivity of the medium in which the charges are present. Default is 8.854 x 10^-12 F/m (vacuum permittivity). This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate the electromagnetic force between two charges. They provide charge1=5 C, charge2=10 C, distance=2 m. For vacuum, medium_permittivity default is 8.854e-12 F/m. For second scenario, relative permittivity is 5e-12? Wait relative permittivity is dimensionless; but they say "相對介電常數為5 x 10^-12 F/m". That seems wrong: relative permittivity should be dimensionless, maybe they mean absolute permittivity? But we will use the given value as medium_permittivity. So we need to call the function twice: once with default medium_permittivity, once with medium_permittivity=5e-12. The function signature expects medium_permittivity optional. So we call twice.

We need to output the results. The function returns any; we assume it returns numeric force. We'll call twice.
